get.summary: Issue an antiforgery token (and cookie) for subsequent POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE requests.
The playlist's tracks in order, without those the viewer can't see.

post.summary: Owner only. Appends a track you can see; adding one that's already there is a no-op.

get.summary: The signed-in artist's albums (any visibility), newest first.

post.summary: Create a track and upload its audio (and optional cover) in one multipart request. All or nothing: on any error no track is created. Location points at the new track.

get.summary: Account picture (JPEG); size is 'small' or 'large'. Use the URLs in MeDto.avatar.
Artist avatar or banner (JPEG); size is 'small' or 'large'. Public. Use the URLs in ArtistDto.avatar / banner.
The signed-in user's playlists, recently updated first (paged). containsTrack fills PlaylistDto.containsTrack.

post.summary: Create an account. Always 202 for valid input; a verification (or 'account exists') email follows.
Sign in; sets the session cookie. Fetch a new CSRF token afterwards.
Revokes the current session and clears the cookie. Idempotent.
Sign in with email + password; returns an access token (Authorization: Bearer) and a rotating refresh token.
Exchange the refresh token for a new pair. Each refresh token works once; reusing one revokes the session.
Sign out a token session by its refresh token. Idempotent.
Change password; signs out every other session.

get.summary: List all genres, ordered by name.
Newest public tracks that are ready to play (paged: page, pageSize ≤ 50).
The signed-in artist's tracks, newest first (paged: page, pageSize ≤ 50).

post.summary: Become an artist: creates the profile and grants the Artist role.

get.summary: Album with the tracks the viewer can see, in order. Private albums: owner only (404 otherwise).

patch.summary: Owner only. Send the full object.

delete.summary: Owner only. The tracks stay; they just leave the album.

put.summary: Owner only. Replaces the tracklist with these of your tracks, in this order (a track moves here from any other album).

get.summary: Top matches of each kind (6) with totals. Accent-insensitive, prefix and typo tolerant. Playlists: GET /playlists?q=.
Ready public tracks matching q (title, description, artist name), best first (paged).

put.summary: Set or replace the signed-in user's account picture: the image as the raw body (JPEG, PNG or WebP, ≥ 200×200, ≤ 10 MB). Cropped square and re-encoded.
Set or replace the signed-in artist's avatar (square, ≥ 200×200) or banner (3:1, ≥ 600×200): the image as the raw body (JPEG, PNG or WebP, ≤ 10 MB). Center-cropped and re-encoded.

get.summary: Cover image (square JPEG); size is 'small' (≈320 px) or 'large' (≈1200 px). Visible to whoever can see the track. Use the URLs in TrackDto.artwork.

put.summary: Set or replace the cover: the image file as the raw request body (JPEG, PNG or WebP).
Upload the original audio as the raw request body. Send its size in X-Upload-Length and optionally its (URL-encoded) name in X-File-Name.

get.summary: Stream and waveform URLs for media players. The URLs carry a short-lived token, so the player needs no Authorization header or cookie.
Public playlists with tracks: matching q (accent-insensitive title search), or newest first (paged).
Private playlists: owner only (404 otherwise). Tracks: GET /playlists/{id}/tracks.

patch.summary: Owner only. Send the full object.

put.summary: Owner only. trackIds = the tracks to reorder (usually all the caller sees), in their new order; they swap among their current positions and tracks left out keep theirs.
